authorization_deadline: runtime_authority.AUTHORIZATION_DEADLINE (currently 2026-10-12T23:59:59+03:00); jobs after it run and hold with authorization_expired

windows.chain_tick: Mon-Fri 09:15-18:30 (runtime_authority.CHAIN_TICK_WINDOW, slot-claim semantics: one claim per 15-min slot, first 5 minutes only)
windows.daily_digest: Mon-Fri first run at/after 09:15 (durable daily-digest-YYYYMMDD record; later runs that day are no-ops)

hamle-account-manager.image: <image built from publish HEAD via package_chain_source.py>

hamle-daily-digest.image: <image built from publish HEAD via package_chain_source.py>
hamle-daily-digest.gcloud: gcloud run jobs create hamle-daily-digest --project=gamechangers-hamle --region=europe-west1 --image=<IMAGE> --service-account=hamle-runtime@gamechangers-hamle.iam.gserviceaccount.com --set-env-vars=<same HAMLE_* env as hamle-account-manager> --command=python --args=worker.py,--mode,daily_digest --tasks=1 --parallelism=1 --max-retries=0 --task-timeout=600s
hamle-daily-digest.why_separate_job: scheduler calls :run without overrides (no run.jobs.runWithOverrides for the scheduler SA); one job per mode keeps default args explicit

scheduler_jobs.note: 09:15 sends; 09:30/09:45 are no-op backups unless the 09:15 run never claimed (never a second mail)

iam.scheduler_invoker_on_both_jobs: roles/run.invoker for hamle-scheduler@ on hamle-account-manager AND hamle-daily-digest
iam.condition: existing 2026-10-12-only IAM condition must be replaced by a window ending at runtime_authority.AUTHORIZATION_DEADLINE when that is extended; otherwise later weekday runs are denied (fail-closed)

apply_sequence: pause + delete the three hamle-pilot-20261012-* jobs (or leave paused)
update hamle-account-manager job (chain_tick args) and create hamle-daily-digest job; describe and compare
create the four scheduler jobs with inert schedule '0 0 1 1 *', pause, patch final schedule, describe PAUSED
resume after digest config + recipients filled and Ahmet confirms
gcloud_scheduler_reference: gcloud scheduler jobs update http <id> --project=gamechangers-hamle --location=europe-west1 --schedule='<final schedule>'
gcloud scheduler jobs describe <id> --project=gamechangers-hamle --location=europe-west1  (require state PAUSED + exact config)
gcloud scheduler jobs resume <id> --project=gamechangers-hamle --location=europe-west1  (activation; costs money per run)
cost: each scheduled start is a billed Cloud Run execution; empty chain_tick slots make 0 model calls; digest makes 0 model calls
